reviews.text: I have been going there since 1995 and the vets here are outstanding. My pets have always received the best care. Thank you!
Super friendly and helpful staff. Thorough, caring vets. Fortunately, we have pet insurance, too ... Our boy is always in good hands here!
Excellent, thorough.  Very caring. Staff attentive and listens to my concerns
Trekkie, thank you for the support! We love caring for your pets!

The staff is very kind, they love lemon and turtle.
Doctors are awesome

Good service
Reasonable price
My dog is happy and healthy

I appreciate all the education I received from the vet and the assistant during my senior cat's annual physical. They were very patient and caring with my cat. Everyone seemed very efficient and professional. I definitely recommend Rancho San Carlos Pet Clinic!
Thank you so much for the 5-star review, Michael. We're glad you had a great experience with us!

My dog was diagnosed with IVDD and we were having a hard time with pain management. He was still able to walk but after a 1.5 months he was still having frequent pain flair ups. I found Dr. Halsey and this clinic online because of her experience with acupuncture and redlight therapy. After the first visit with acupuncture my dog did so much better. He was immediately in less pain. Her and her staff worked with us to find a way to manage his pain with treatment and work with our budget. She was so knowledgeable about how to wean my dog off of pain meds and what to do if he had another problem. I went in to her thinking that my dog would eventually need surgery and it has been over 6 months and he has been totally great! I cannot recommend her and her staff enough. Anyone I know with a pet I've recommend to come here. She was very kind, compassionate and knowledgeable. Thank you!!

This review is long overdue. Our 5 year old dog became very sick last April and between, Rancho San Carlos, Tell Tail, and Moonlight, they gave her such good care. They were also so compassionate and patient with me and all my questions. She became sick again in January and ended up needing emergency surgery which was performed at Rancho San Carlos within hours.  We were so grateful to not have to take her to the big box ER. Again, exceptional skill and care was given to our girl and to us. We now have established that she has some serious GI issues and have been to Tell Tail and Moonlight again for emergency anti-nausea meds and ultrasounds. I can't speak enough to how helpful it is that they have the two associated urgent cares (Tell Tail and Moonlight). With our dogs complicated history, it is amazing that we get to see the same doctors and her history is all in one place for all three facilities. We love all the doctors so much and they have been amazing through a very stressful and worrisome time.
Absolutely love them. Dr. Perry and Sam are true Kitty lovers, they were so gentle and kind. Dr. Perry explains everything in a thoughtful manner. Grateful we found Rancho San Carlos Pet Clinic.

Dr. Francioli is so passionate about what she does as a veterinarian and truly cares about the animals she treats. She explains the procedures and why they are necessary to maintain our dog’s health. I would highly recommend her for your pet.

I took my first cat Fudge there for over 16 years. Towards the end he needed fluids for his kidneys. A vet tech name Sam was usually the one - she was/is absolutely wonderful with our precious furbabies.  I now have a ginger cat named "19" and they are great with him as well. I wouldn't consider taking him to another other clinic !!! All the staff/doctors are so caring and wonderful people.

I love this office.   I have been trusting them with my babies for 3 years now and hands down can say I would absolutely recommend.   Everyone that works here is very kinds and treat me and my babies with great care.
Simply the best!
Well organized loving vet clinique. This is my place of choice from now on.

We just started going here and already love it! Everyone was super nice! We originally went in for a checkup and acupuncture and our pup was pretty nervous in the new place. The nurse and the doctor took time to calm him and get to know him better. He did calm down some and we decided to get laser for the first treatment so he would feel more comfortable.  We are excited to continue to come here to continue treatment for our boy.
Now we bring both for pups here, everyone here is awesome and we couldn't ask for better care

Took my golden, Duchess,  in for a skin growth near her eye. While examining her Dr Limber found a fractured molar. She suggested taking care of both needs while Duchess was under sedation.
All the staff I interacted with were extremely helpful and responsive. They made sure we had everything going into surgery. Dr Limber called with updates and  was able to save the tooth. She took her time to explain everything to me which I greatly appreciated. Duchess got sent home with a personalized after care letter and I received a follow up call the next day, checking on Duchess since she returned home.
I truly felt Duchess received care from a great team who really cared about her. As a pet owner this means a great deal!

Our pets are our world, and finding a veterinarian you truly trust is so hard. Dr. Fransioli is absolutely amazing. We have two cats, Roy Kent and POTUS Bader Ginsburg, and a dog named Abbey, and they absolutely ADORE Dr. Fransioli! She always remembers the little details about them, which makes us trust her care completely.

The entire experience at Rancho San Carlos Vet is top-notch — communication is excellent, scheduling is easy, the online portal is convenient for appointments and prescription food, and we love the text and call reminders. They even follow up after visits to check on how our pets are doing. All of their techs are amazing!

On a personal level, Dr. Fransioli remembers details about our lives too, which means so much to us. We love her so much that both me and my wife go to appointments just to see and catch up with her! We couldn’t recommend her more!

All The female doctors are so caring and they put the pets first.
There is a positive vibe within that vet office. You can feel it. No doom and gloom.Thank you all for your great service you provide  are pets Don from San Diego.
Very welcoming receptionists and staff. Dr. was extremely helpful and took her time to explain everything. It was a great first visit. Parking convenient. Highly recommended.
The Staff is very attentive and takes great care of Riley and Benji!!

Awful place. Made an appointment months in advance, spend an hour uploading years of records to their portal, gave my dog trazadone to prep him for the appt, but was running late bc my foster was sick and had to go to another vet that day. Called them to let them know and they said I’d be too late to make the appointment so they cancelled it. They then charged me a no show fee even though I said I was still coming, and refused to credit that towards another appointment when I called to reschedule. They also had the audacity to recommend I go someplace else that didn’t require an appointment ??? I couldn’t even get my dogs meds filled and had scramble to find another vet before they ran out that week (which I told them was one of the reasons for my appt). I would not recommend this place for anyone. Don’t waste your time with them. Life happens, especially with dogs. A little understanding, kindness, and compassion goes a long way. These people clearly have none of those things. They were terrible to deal with.
Look no further for your vet. Everyone is knowledgeable, friendly, and efficient
Dr. Limber was so knowledgeable and patient. She took the time to go through my list of concerns and came up with a game plan with different options that fell within my budget.
Cool
Thank you for the 5 stars!
Wonderful veterinarian office! They are very caring and always check in after appointments. The doctor was super booked but made sure she saw my dog.
Thank you for the 5 stars!

My recent  visit to the Rancho San Carlos Pet Clinic  was rewarding both for me , and for my little dog. Turns out Baby Girl  has a rectal prolapse.  Without treatment that condition can be deadly.    The clinic staff was very clear in describing the problem, and displayed their professionalism by setting up early treatment.   They are always good to work with.

We had such a good experience taking our pup Wifi to Rancho San Carlos Pet Clinic.  We had a bit of an emergency on Wednesday, as our pup Wifi had eaten some deli meat that contained garlic powder and onion powder.  Once we realized the ingredients (unfortunately AFTER we fed it to Wifi), we immediately called Rancho San Carlos Pet Clinic and told them of the emergency, and they had us come in right away so that they could give Wifi something to make her throw up these potential deadly toxins.  Not only were we able to get in right away, but Dr. Rodriquez and staff were so amazing in the way that they cared for Wifi upon arrival until the time we brought her home.  We are so blessed that our little Wifi is now on the mend and it is all thanks for Dr. Rodriquez and staff at Ranch San Carlos Pet Clinic.
Amazing standard of care.

All of the staff at RSCPC are amazing. You can tell they love all animals and are good to both of my dogs. Their vets are all very thorough in their exams and treatment plans. Overall it’s a wonderful pet clinic that takes great care of our pets.

This clinic is special. They’re caring, attentive, and I highly recommend them. They’ve helped my dog for years and I fully trust them.

To the vets and staff, thank you for helping me over the years. - Sadie’s dad

They take amazing care of both our dogs, one with special needs. They are responsive via business messaging and telephone calls. All of the vets collaborate interdisciplinary with each other, you get a whole team of experts for your animals.

What really impressed me with their practices, when you get your animal back after procedure, they write a letter from the dogs perspective, it was so cute and heartwarming really connected to me with the vets.
I’ve always had wonderful experiences at our vet office. Everyone is so kind and helpful. We are happy we found somewhere we can trust to bring our babies!

I’ve been to a lot of vets over the years… BIG shoutout to Dr Herman & Dr Fransioli. They are the two best vets I have ever had in San Diego for my cats and dogs. They are both educated, competent, kind, and respectful.
Thank you for your review!
Staff and dr Perry are great to work with my dog, Chloey. They  are caring and knowledgeable about animals.
All the staffs are so kind and gentle with Ginger. They always gave options and give a call checking how is she doing
Rancho San Carlos Pet Clinic. Linsey Hackett DMV was so professional, kind and answered all my questions. She was so nice with Ginger. Ginger was so happy to say hi to the girls at the receptionist.

Dr Halsey and her team are the best of the best! Dr Halsey is an absolute gem who is so knowledgeable and truly wants the best for your pet. I’ve been taking my 5 year old cavachon who has been having back issues for a few months now and I can see a huge difference from his old vet compared to Dr Halsey. His old vet just pushed for meds and wanted us out the door and wasn’t personable at all. Dr Halsey is the complete opposite and I’m so happy I found her. She is so kind, loving, and welcoming! Even the team at the front desk is welcoming on the phone and in person. I have had the best experience every visit. Highly recommend taking your beloved pets here! Thank you Dr Halsey and team :)

I have taken my dog bailey to rancho San Carlos pet clinic for a long time now.    They are very thorough and Very knowledgeable. I feel safe taking my dog here. They know her really well and take every precaution. They're  On top of what my pets needs. The whole staff are kind and wonderful.  My dog loves everyone there. Love all the vets.  They all are amazing.  They are so patient and nice there.  My dog is in the best care with them. I have referred  people to go there

The staff are very caring of the animals they treat.  My dog has a compressed spinal cord and lost her hind legs mobility. Dr. Halsey has been treating her with acupuncture and massage which has been helping. She doesn't push and force.  Her main concern is my dogs comfort level.  She's had patience.  All the vets and staff support each other and see each others patients. Thank you to everyone at this clinic.
Every vet and tech here are professional, kind, and sensitive to costs and procedures. By far my favorite place to have my cats and dogs seen. Highly recommend.

If you’re looking for a genuine provider, I highly recommend this place. We live in Little Italy & drove out of our way per a friend’s recommendation. The experience was even better than I anticipated.

Dr Perry and the crew at Rancho San Carlos are absolutely wonderful! They take their time and don’t make you feel rushed, allow for plenty of questions and are very thorough. Coco and I both are grateful and happy we are a part of the family!!
Excellent local NON-franchised pet hospital with excellent Drs who take the time during examinations and diagnoses.  Highly recommend!
Thank you for your review!

In 15 years of owning pets, I’ve never worked with a clinic where all of the veterinarians were so committed to giving thorough, exceptional care! Our dog has a lot of special needs and I always know they have our best interests as the priority. We are so grateful to have found them and that they’re willing to work with our unique dog ha!

I am grateful we changed to Rancho San Carlos Pet Clinic, they are THE BEST place to take your fur baby for excellent care. They truly take time to exam your pet and listen to you and any concern. Not to mention everyone is so sweet and loving to your animal.
Pet received dental care and  it went great.  Appointment and admin was exceptional. No long wait and picking up pet was on time.
I love this place! The level of friendliness, professionalism, and kindness is beyond 5 stars.  I would rate 100 stars if that were an option.
Dr. Perry is great!

One of the new Vet’s has really dropped the ball.  Communication with her is lacking, she gave me just one option and recommendation for my very sick pet.  When I had another vet look over my pets labs they were shocked with her recommendation and said there could be many things going on and they gave me other avenues to explore before sedating my sick fur baby.  They used to be great and since Covid it’s been hit or miss. Hard to get an appointment at times booked weeks out. The front office staff and nurses are very sweet. The office is very clean.

This is the most wonderful Vet clinic. The time and love our doctors and technicians put in to make our big drama queen feel comfortable to get blood drawn is phenomenal So many other vets gave up on him, but not Rancho San Carlos Pet Clinic!!!!
This is a great vet clinic! They are caring and very informative. I would recommend coming here.

Whether you make a phone call or walk through the front door it's immediately evident that everyone at RSCPC is there to help your furry friend. The staff at the front desk, the doctors, the techs and everyone behind the scenes truly work to give my dogs the best care. They take the time to explain everything I need to know about procedures and medications - and they make a point of getting to know my dogs' specific personalities and needs. Thank you Rancho San Carlos Pet Clinic!
Thank you for your review!
Thank you for your review!
